g.text: Multi-Slot WOV & Dual-Rate ECNS Pipeline Architecture
Dual-Rate DMIC (48k & 16k), 20ms DP ECNS (+30dB Boost), 2.0s KPB Pre-roll, 3 MWW Slots (Hi Intel), and WOV Arbiter
SOF NOTIFIER BUS & INTER-MODULE SIGNALING PROTOCOL:
1. NOTIFIER_ID_WOV_DETECT: Detector notifies Arbiter (slot_id) FIRST so Arbiter latches the route before KPB empties.
2. NOTIFIER_ID_KPB_CLIENT_EVT: Detector notifies KPB to drain 2.0s history to Arbiter (dcache writeback/invalidate coherency).
3. NOTIFIER_ID_WOV_CTRL: Arbiter broadcasts WOV_ARB_CMD_PAUSE to suppress sibling detector slots during host streaming.
4. SOF_IPC4_MODULE_NOTIFICATION: Firmware asynchronously pushes Phrase Detect ID & 2 Hz Volatile Scoring updates to ALSA driver.
